name: svelte-native
description: Svelte Native: Svelte 5 on React Native Fabric, with no React. The library, its Expo modules and the QA harness.

scripts.lint: biome check . && pnpm --dir packages/svelte-native lint && pnpm --dir apps/qa lint && pnpm --dir apps/example lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/svelte-native typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/qa typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/qa native-qa:typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/example typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/svelte-native test && pnpm --dir apps/qa native-qa:test && pnpm --dir apps/example test
